exposure: urinary incontinence in their previous pregnancies
outcome: Bristol Female Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms-Short Form (BFLUTS-SF) scores
cohort: 158 female nurses and 105 female civil servants working at a hospital
finding: The prevalence of at least one LUTS was 94.2% in nurses and 97.1% in civil servants, with urgency and urge incontinence being the most common symptoms.
mod_finding: The authors note that BFLUTS-SF scores differed between groups when analyzed by mode of delivery (cesarean and vaginal).
